descriptor: Live-looking currency converter and rate ticker

voice.summary: Mintly Rates speaks in the crisp, numerate tone of a currency desk that still wants to be understood. Rates are shown with direction and size of change, and everything says plainly that the figures are examples.
dos: Show the pair and the rate together
Label sample data as sample data
Use arrows and signs for rate movement
donts: Never show a rate without its pair

taglines: Know the number before you go
boilerplate: Mintly Rates is a currency converter with a scrolling rate ticker, 30-day sparkline and saved pairs, showing illustrative rates that update every few seconds.

microcopy.error: Could not fetch that pair. Try another.
microcopy.empty: No favourite pairs yet. Star one to keep it here.

logo.note: Coins are the clearest visual shorthand for currency.
